title: A Phone Call About Fatimah's Quiet Strength
script: Amir: [thoughtful] Mom, I read something today about Fatimah, the Prophet's youngest daughter, and I wanted to ask you about it.
Mother: [warmly] Of course. Fatimah's life is one I've loved learning about since I was young myself.
Amir: [curious] The article said her family lived very simply, even though her father was the Prophet. Is that accurate?
Mother: [nodding] Completely accurate. Sometimes their home had almost no food, and Fatimah worked constantly, grinding grain until her hands ached badly.
Amir: [surprised] That sounds exhausting. Didn't she ever ask her father for an easier life, considering who he was?
Mother: [gently] She did ask once, actually. She wanted a servant to help with the heavy, endless housework she faced every single day.
Amir: [curious] What did the Prophet say when she asked him for help?
Mother: [reflective] Instead of giving her a servant, he taught her special words to say before sleeping, promising they would bring lasting strength.
Amir: [thoughtful] So he offered comfort for her heart, rather than simply removing her difficult physical work?
Mother: [warmly] Exactly, and Fatimah accepted this answer without complaint, because she trusted her father's wisdom completely, even when it surprised her.
Amir: [interested] Was she close to her father in other ways too?
Mother: [smiling] Very close. Whenever he traveled and returned home, she was often the first person he visited, before anyone else.
Amir: [curious] That's touching. Did she stay strong even after he passed away?
Mother: [sadly] She grieved deeply, since losing him affected her more than almost anyone else in the entire community.
Amir: [reflective] It sounds like her strength wasn't about having an easy life, but about carrying hardship with real grace and quiet dignity.
Mother: [warmly] Exactly, my son. That's why so many people still admire her, even so many centuries later.

quiz.question: How did Fatimah's family live, according to the mother?
options: Extremely wealthy
Very simply, sometimes with almost no food
Surrounded by servants
In a large palace
quiz.explanation: The mother says their home had almost no food, and Fatimah worked constantly grinding grain.

quiz.question: What did Fatimah once ask her father for?
options: More money
A servant to help with heavy housework
A larger house
A trip to another city
quiz.explanation: She asked for a servant to help with the heavy, endless housework she faced every day.

quiz.question: How did the Prophet respond to her request?
options: He gave her a servant immediately
He taught her special words to say before sleeping for strength
He refused to answer her
He sent her away
quiz.explanation: Instead of giving her a servant, he taught her special words to say before sleeping, promising lasting strength.

quiz.question: How did Fatimah react to her father's answer?
options: She complained loudly
She accepted it without complaint, trusting his wisdom
She refused to speak to him
She asked someone else for help
quiz.explanation: Fatimah accepted this answer without complaint, because she trusted her father's wisdom completely.

quiz.question: What is the mother's main point about Fatimah's strength?
options: It came from having an easy life
It came from carrying hardship with grace and quiet dignity
It came from her wealth
It came from avoiding all difficulty
quiz.explanation: The mother concludes that Fatimah's strength was about carrying hardship with real grace and quiet dignity.
